evidence: Canonical source diff inspected: one Pathways overview removal and six reflection-prompt removals

adversarialFindings.description: The implementation session is also performing the review; independence is absent.
adversarialFindings.resolution: The owner explicitly authorized proceeding without a separate reviewer on 2026-11-08. The exception is disclosed; this record makes no independence claim. Hosted release validation remains mandatory.

adversarialFindings.description: Six edited reflection prompts receive new content hashes. Previously recorded answers remain stored but are not presented as current answers.
adversarialFindings.resolution: This follows the existing content-versioning model. The owner was informed before retaining the direct-copy candidate. No evidence deletion or schema change is part of this remediation.

adversarialFindings.description: The proprietary terms cannot revoke permissions previously granted under MIT, or override third-party rights.
adversarialFindings.resolution: Sections 1 and 4 explicitly preserve previously granted rights and third-party ownership. The review is not a legal opinion.

adversarialFindings.description: Nine sequential route scans in a single Playwright test exhausted the 30-second test budget during hosted release validation.
adversarialFindings.resolution: Split the existing light and dark route coverage into three independent groups of three routes each. Preserve all readiness assertions and Axe scans; do not increase timeouts.

retrospective.summary: Proceed through the existing hosted release gate. The source changes preserve the intended learning content, LICENSE terms and RPG Axe coverage. Same-session AI review remains disclosed.
